verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's docs confirm that transfers are part of the Domains API surface ([godaddy-docs-8], [godaddy-docs-34]). Transfers are commercial mutations gated by a quoteToken from a quote endpoint, which implies upfront cost disclosure ([godaddy-docs-35]). Beyond these thin mentions, the pack contains no transfer-in guide. Missing for 10: documented EPP/auth-code submission flow, transfer status tracking/polling, explicit transfer pricing details, handling of remaining registration time, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the transfer-in experience.
